name: ipums_la_97-small
rationale: Census documentation explicitly describes household cluster sampling and flattened household/person records; row partitions ignore households.

name: Pulsar-Dataset-HTRU2
rationale: Eight signal-summary predictors, not raw sequences. Human labels are documented, but source-object identities and whether multiple candidates represent a pulsar are not established; no positional data are retained.

name: football-player-position
rationale: Player-level aggregates and position labels are described, but no collection source, player IDs or season deduplication are documented; repeated players and synthetic origin cannot be resolved.

name: hepatitis_c_virus_hcv_for_egyptian_patients
rationale: UCI documents 1385 Egyptian patients; repeated-time laboratory measurements are columns, not repeated rows. Histological staging is the target and grading is a distinct measurement. No target-defining column or common source with either benchmark is documented.

name: BitcoinHeist_Ransomware
rationale: Original BitcoinHeist documentation describes address features extracted in daily windows and addresses recurring across windows. Removing addresses and year does not establish independent rows.

name: Pumpkin_Seeds
rationale: Original study documents measurements of 2500 seeds, two varieties, and 12 morphological features. This is a tabular measurement task, not retained images. The later TabArena IID collection is outside the declared v0.1 exclusion; no shared raw source in the 295-row registry.

name: Mobile_Price
rationale: Curated task links to a Kaggle mobile-price exercise but does not document empirical collection or label construction; curation alone does not verify non-synthetic origin.

name: depression_2020
rationale: Rural survey description removes Survey_id and Ville_id and says some columns are unexplained. Household/village clustering and collection provenance cannot be resolved.

name: NewspaperChurn
rationale: Actual retained predictors include unique SubscriptionID and Address. Records are subscriptions, but multiple subscriptions per household/person and treatment of address text are not documented.

name: Interest_Rate
rationale: Generic loan description lacks collection source and how the three interest-rate classes were formed. Actual 12 predictors do not include a continuous interest-rate field; this is not proof of eligible origin.

name: US_Stocks_Financial_Indicators
rationale: Retained 2019_price_var determines class by its sign (zero maps to increase); checked on every stored row. Creator documentation defines class from price variation.

name: solar-flare
rationale: UCI describes active solar regions and 24-hour flare counts; the PMLB upload supplies only flare-pmlb as description. Region recurrence and exact target transformation cannot be verified from the retained ten features.

name: Multiclass_Classification_for_Corporate_Credit_Ratings
rationale: spid is retained and has 4969 distinct values among 5000 records. Corporate-rating source cites a book/article but does not establish whether repeated identifiers are repeated entities or simulated data.

name: MembershipWoes
rationale: An assignment narrative describes club cancellations, with retained membership number and start/end dates. Empirical origin and whether end date reveals cancellation are undocumented.

name: dataset_china
rationale: Retained five-level_classification has 11 values, each mapping to exactly one five_categories class over all 27522 rows. This is a second encoding of the classification outcome, not an admissible predictor.

name: analcatdata_supreme
rationale: Binarized Supreme Court task lacks original target identity and case/justice keys; 3479 repeated full rows among 4052 records. Repeated case votes cannot be resolved from the description and seven retained attributes.

name: Phishing_Legitimate_full
rationale: Tan source documents real phishing/legitimate webpage collections. Domain/website group keys are absent, and whether multiple pages belong to the same site is unresolved; numerical URL summaries are not themselves disqualifying text.

name: WBCAtt
rationale: WBCAtt uses eleven tabular morphology annotations, not pixels. Original paper says annotators could see cell type, and patient grouping of the underlying PBC images is not established in this upload; label-informed features and repeated donors require resolution.

name: kr-vs-kp
rationale: UCI describes a generated chess endgame database of board positions. Distinct from TabRepo King-Rook-King, but still an artificial task under criterion A.

name: EDA-Home-Mortgage-NY-Sampled
rationale: action_taken is the mortgage application outcome while denial_reason_1 and purchaser_type are retained. HMDA dictionary defines denial reasons for denied applications and purchaser type for originated/purchased loans; these are outcome-side information.

name: Risk_Level_Classification
rationale: Retained risk_score separates all three anomaly classes into disjoint ordered ranges on every row (low below 60, moderate 60 to below 90, high at least 90). The risk-class task retains its defining risk score; synthetic origin is not needed for exclusion.

name: South_Asian_Churn_dataset
rationale: SATO source documents real South Asian wireless-customer data. Monthly behaviour is represented in columns of a customer record; thirteen predictors contain no Class alias. Source differs from the US telecom churn/IBM fictional collections.

name: Otto-Group-Product-Classification-Challenge
rationale: Otto competition documentation specifies one product per row, 93 event-count predictors, and nine product categories. The loader drops the declared id. No benchmark or earlier selected source matches this product collection.

name: Credit_Score
rationale: The generic company-metrics description conflicts with personal credit features matching the Kaggle credit-score schema. Customer/month keys are absent; repeated-customer and synthetic provenance are not settled by this upload.

name: Skin_Cancer_PAD-UFES-20
rationale: Exact metadata documents 2298 image records from 1373 patients/1641 lesions with only patient_id and lesion_id deleted. Actual target is biopsed, not cancer diagnosis; diagnostic and img_id remain. Grouping persists after ID removal.

name: open_payments
rationale: CMS payment records can repeat recipients/manufacturers. This processed upload contains only five predictors and status, with no recipient key or documented aggregation/target derivation; grouping cannot be verified.

name: banknote-authentication
rationale: UCI documents genuine/forged banknote specimens with four wavelet summary measurements and authenticity labels. No raw images, target alias or shared benchmark source. Duplicate measurement rows alone do not establish repeated specimens.

name: student_depression_dataset
rationale: Generic student-depression description does not identify a survey instrument, empirical sampling or label construction. It cannot verify non-synthetic origin or absence of a symptom-derived target.

name: Employee
rationale: Later TabArena IID curation is outside v0.1, but notes roughly 40 percent duplicates. Employee identifiers are absent and collection/synthesis history is not established; duplicates alone do not prove repeated employees.

name: Cardiovascular-Disease-dataset
rationale: Creator describes 70000 patient examinations with eleven demographic/examination/lifestyle predictors and disease target. The loader drops id; target is not retained among predictors. Collection institution is unspecified, a source limitation, but no documented synthetic, grouped-row or benchmark overlap failure.

name: compas-two-years
rationale: ProPublica two-year recidivism person table, transformed by tabular-benchmark. Retained features are baseline demographics and prior counts, not recidivism outcome fields. Repeated feature vectors do not imply repeated persons. Later compass variant is excluded as the same source.

name: clean2
rationale: UCI documents 6598 conformations of 102 molecules and excludes molecule_name/conformation_name from predictive use. Both are retained; actual molecule_name has 102 levels, each with a single class.

name: HMEQ_Data_New
rationale: SAS HMEQ documentation and linked source describe 5960 home-equity loan records with BAD default outcome and twelve credit/application features. No retained target copy or common benchmark source; subsequent HMEQ uploads are the same selected source.

name: national-longitudinal-survey-binary
rationale: income96 is retained while income96gt17 is its binary threshold at 1.7. Every row satisfies this mapping. The description typo income90 does not change the actual retained feature/target evidence.

name: Credit-Risk-Classification-Dataset
rationale: Anonymized fea_* features and id are retained. Citation locates a Kaggle task but gives no collection or target semantics adequate to rule out synthetic origin, grouping or outcome-derived features.

name: Credit_Risk_Modeling
rationale: approved_flag and retained credit_score have nearly disjoint ranges but not an exact mapping. Generic AutoML description and unrelated Metaverse citation do not establish label generation. Near-perfect association alone is not confirmed leakage.

name: PostPartum_Depression
rationale: Source reports 1503 hospital questionnaire records and Feeling_anxious response target, not a clinical diagnosis. 1177 exact duplicate rows and absent respondent IDs leave repeated responses/empirical origin unresolved.

name: KDD98
rationale: KDD98 documents donor mailing responses. TARGET_B is retained as target; TARGET_D (same-mailing donation) and CONTROLN are absent from predictors. Historical mailing fields are predictors. Distinct from KDD09, KDD99 and KDD Internet sources in the registry.

name: Advanced_IoT_Dataset
rationale: Greenhouse description has 30000 plant records and a Random batch indicator with R1/R2/R3. It does not establish independent plants versus repeated/batch-generated measurements or explain the Class labels sufficiently.

name: air-quality-and-pollution-assessment
rationale: Description cites general WHO/World Bank portals without a reproducible station/time join, collection identifiers or label-generation rule. Neither empirical provenance nor independence of air-quality labels from pollutants can be verified.

name: rl
rationale: 4Paradigm challenge deliberately conceals the source identity; the numeric/categorical matrix alone cannot verify the no-overlap, non-artificial or independent-row criteria.

name: Fraud-Detection-Updated
rationale: Upload contains placeholder creator/citation and generic fraud description. Retained overdue dates and delinquency counts may be outcome-side; no source or target definition resolves this.

name: Support2
rationale: death is the target but hospdead, d.time and sfdm2 remain predictors. SUPPORT documentation identifies hospital death, follow-up and a disability level encoding death before two months; the prediction task includes outcome information.

name: mushroom
rationale: UCI describes hypothetical samples of mushroom species from a field guide, not independent collected mushrooms; excludes artificial data regardless of the observed experimental effect.

name: law-school-admission-bianry
rationale: fairml law-school cohort describes individual students. Target is thresholded undergraduate GPA; ugpa itself is absent from the ten predictors, unlike income96 in the longitudinal task. Post-admission fields limit prospective interpretation but do not define the target. No benchmark source match.

name: Santander_Customer_Satisfaction
rationale: Kaggle documents customer satisfaction classification with anonymized numeric predictors; ID removed and TARGET absent from predictors. Different competition/data collection from TabRepo Santander transaction-value regression; no documented shared records. Anonymization limits semantic checks.
